title: Preserve an embedded sequence while replacing positional ownership
goal: Replace synthetic ordinal identity with a complex JSON collection when upgrading owned embedded lists to EF11; preserve values and order while reviewing schema and data migration separately.

selectionNotes: Owned JSON collections without key; schema/data migration reviewed separately.
Complex JSON collections already exist in EF10; this edition addresses the EF11 deprecation and does not add a .NET10 foundation.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires .NET 11. No older-runtime EF11 route is offered.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the net11.0 consumer; measured SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 is RC2 evidence, not GA proof.

language.reason: Declared current language mode; no C# 15-specific syntax is required by the example.

frameworks: Microsoft.NET.Sdk console consumer; no ASP.NET Core framework requirement

packages.name: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite

packageAssets: EF Core and Relational lib/net11.0; Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core lib/net10.0; actual resolved graph and content hashes pinned in packages.lock.json
Previous consumer: EF/SQLite 10.0.13 on net10.0, SDK 10.0.402, C# 14.0; current consumer: EF/SQLite 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 on net11.0, SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105, C# 15.0
providers: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite; actual disposable file shared between the EF10 and EF11 consumers, not EF InMemory or mocked SQL

Measured Windows x64: previous native SQLite 3.53.3 via SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3/core/lib.e_sqlite3/provider.e_sqlite3 2.1.13; current SQLite 3.53.4 via SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3/config.e_sqlite3/core/provider.e_sqlite3 3.0.5 and the separate SQLite package 3.53.4.
platforms: Executed on Windows x64 with packaged e_sqlite3 native library. Other OS/architecture/native routes require their own suitable SQLite assets; none executed here.
renderingModes: Not applicable: console/database model; no browser or rendering mode
constraints: Owned JSON collections without key; schema/data migration reviewed separately.
Demonstrated route is a complex JSON collection with value semantics; no supported keyed-owned provider route is established here.
Old SQLite column allows NULL; new required collection generates NOT NULL. The fixture reads and edits the old table without applying a production migration.
prerequisites: Restore locked dependencies online before running consumers; installed Playbook guidance is complete offline.
Seed a new disposable local SQLite file with the EF10 consumer, then open that exact file with the EF11 consumer. Never use a production database.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API shape in GA-targeted guidance, measured on RC2 packages and SDK. No experimental API suppression required. Actual GA reconciliation remains outstanding.

sources.title: EF11 owned JSON collection diagnostic and mitigations
EF10 complex types and JSON availability

evidence.scope: Actual owned shadow-key model, SQLite array storage without JSON identity, ordered duplicate/empty values and original data creation for the EF11 migration check.

Actual EF10 SQLite file consumed by EF11 complex collection; old mapping diagnostic, complex metadata, no pre-edit rewrite, duplicate/order/empty preservation, remove/edit/append with fresh reload, existing schema retained and different generated NOT NULL DDL. Not a production migration.

humanProof.scope: Automated actual SQLite model and data checks cover this bounded complex-collection route. No Human proof is required; production schema/data review, other providers/platforms and GA remain separate.
